recentItems.title: Gachagua kicks off public engagements in Washington
recentItems.description:
DCP leader Rigathi Gachagua is in spokane, Washington State for a week-long engagement with Kenyans living in the area. 
Gachagua who left Kenya 10 days ago for a two-month tour of the United States is expected to hold discussions and explore ways on how kenyans in the diaspora can contribute to the development and future of Kenya. Noting that diaspora remittances have surpassed tea and coffee as Kenya's largest source of foreign exchange, the DCP leader says there is need for better management of resources in the country. In his first engagement, Gachagua was hosted by community elders over a meal while his wife Reverend Dorcas Rigathi was hosted by Kenyan women for an informal dinner.

recentItems.title: Police seize bhang haul during raid in Bomet town
recentItems.description: Police in Bomet town have launched a manhunt for a drug dealer after a high-stakes raid uncovered a haul of narcotics and illicit alcohol meant to be sold to local youth and university students.

recentItems.title: Three missing Mombasa students rescued in Nairobi
recentItems.description: Police in Mombasa have arrested a human rights activist and politician in connection with the disappearance of two Form Three students in the Kiambini area, Kisauni Constituency, Mombasa County.

recentItems.title: Garissa multi-sectorial stakeholders hold crisis meeting on El-Nino
recentItems.description:
Multi-sectoral stakeholders in Garissa have stepped up preparations for the anticipated El Niño rains expected to begin in the first week of October.
Governor Nathif Jama on Friday chaired a high-level preparedness meeting, bringing together officials from the county and national governments, the Kenya Meteorological Department, NDMA, Kenya Red Cross Society and other partners.

recentItems.title: Murder suspect escapes from police custody in Kisii
recentItems.description: Police in Kisii have launched investigations into the mysterious disappearance of a murder suspect, Lenox Nyawanga, who was arrested over the alleged killing of his father, Jared Otungo, a fortnight ago in Tabaka, South Mugirango, Kisii County.

recentItems.title: Five people killed in road accident along Eldoret-Nakuru highway
recentItems.description: Five people have died, and eight others were seriously injured in a road accident along the Nakuru–Eldoret highway at the Twin’s Bridge black spot. Kuresoi base commander Willy Lang’at said the Eldoret-bound matatu, belonging to Kapsowar SACCO, was speeding when it rammed a stationary trailer. Among the victims are two members of the same family who were travelling back home after attending the administration police pass-out parade in Nairobi for their kin.

Voi set for new football and athletics stadium
recentItems.description:
Voi is set to get a new stadium for football and athletics if renovation works at Vindo Stadium in Taita Taveta County proceed according to schedule.

The facility is expected to provide a major boost to sports development in the region.

recentItems.title: Tusker ready for CAF Confederation Cup opener
recentItems.description:
Mozzart Cup champions Tusker FC are set to face Sudanese side Al Ahli Madani in the first preliminary round of the 2026/27 CAF Confederation Cup.

The match will be played at Kigali Pele Stadium in Rwanda on Saturday, with the return leg scheduled for Nairobi on September 12.
